title: Forms & Settings panels
question: Same drawer / bottom-sheet grammar. What opens the panel on Forms and Settings?

options.label: Responses + inline settings
options.thesis: Forms: response list on stage; click a response for the panel. Settings: preference rows stay on stage (no panel)—only Delete / dangerous actions confirm.
options.viewport: Forms mirrors Registrations density. Settings stays a flush switch stack under the tab.
options.risk: Settings feels less Luma-panel than the other tabs.

options.label: Both use panels
options.thesis: Forms: stage summary + Manage form / response click opens panel. Settings: grouped rows (Payments, Booking, Danger); each group opens a panel.
options.viewport: Every tab’s deep work happens in the right drawer on desktop / sheet on mobile.
options.risk: Settings panels can feel like extra hops for a single toggle.

options.label: Form editor panel, settings on stage
options.thesis: Forms stage shows attach status + responses; Edit form / Change form opens the editor in a panel. Settings stay flush switches on stage.
options.viewport: Yellow only on Attach / Save in panels. Settings never leave the stage.
options.risk: Form editor in a drawer can feel tight on desktop.
